items.text: 49ers ruled out Mike Evans (Achilles) and Deebo Samuel for Sunday vs Falcons. Shanahan confirmed Evans out.
items.why: Official ruling; Shanahan on Evans Achilles.
items.implication: Massive WR vacuum funnels to Kittle and remaining options.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) minor per tests but up-in-air; McVay says felt lack of power/explosion, will test pregame. Questionable, game-time decision vs Raiders.
items.why: Left Thursday practice; imaging minor but not nothing; no full explosion.
items.implication: If out, heavy TE/RB target funnel; monitor pregame.
items.opportunity: Higbee primary, then Mumpfield/Parkinson if inactive.

items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet headed to IR with season-ending serious knee injury suffered Thursday night; coach Ben Johnson confirmed. Schefter corroborates placement on IR.
items.why: Carted off Thursday, tests confirm serious knee; Johnson: season-ending, big part of heartbeat.
items.implication: Loveland becomes clear TE1; fewer multi-TE sets boosts WR routes.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for Colston Loveland; reduced 2/3-TE sets elevate Luther Burden route rate.

items.text: Saquon Barkley looks set to return Week 7 vs Cowboys. Berry and Stephania Bell: if out there, goes right back into fantasy lineups.
items.why: Return indicators + efficiency history; start immediately if active.

items.text: Stephania Bell worried about Breece Hall straight back in lineups Week 7. Berry: if Hall plays vs Dolphins, right back into starting lineup.
items.why: Talent/role overrides caution if cleared for MIA matchup.
items.implication: Start if active; monitor final status.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps vs soft MIA.
items.conflict: Stephania more cautious on immediate return volume.

items.text: Ravens officially list QB Lamar Jackson questionable vs Bengals (high ankle sprain). Jackson: 'heading in the right direction.'
items.why: Official report + player comments on progress.
items.implication: Monitor for start/sit; if out major Ravens offense downgrade.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford target hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen. Expect more run-heavy.
items.why: McVay pregame test quotes + current depth chart/usage data.
items.implication: Higbee TE1 upside; Kyren/Corum boost; lower Stafford pass volume.
items.opportunity: TE/RB target share expansion; Higbee top-10 TE potential.

items.text: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) OUT Week 7. 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB production 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB catches high. Sweet setup for Bijan Robinson full workload.
items.why: BRob listed out + SF RB reception/DvP data last 4 weeks.
items.implication: Bijan clear workhorse vs favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: Full snaps, targets, carries, goal-line vs soft SF run/pass D to RBs.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts Sunday: awesome player + scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo out). Not because of National TE Day.
items.why: WR injuries create target vacuum in Shanahan offense.
items.implication: Elite TE1 ceiling this week and while WRs sidelined.
items.opportunity: High route share, red-zone, volume spike.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet injury may reduce 2- and 3-TE sets, giving Burden even more juice.
items.why: Route rate data + Kmet snap/route share removal likely expands WR opportunities.
items.implication: Burden elevated for more consistent targets/routes ROS and this week.
items.opportunity: Higher route participation and YPRR leverage post-Kmet.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out RB Zach Charbonnet for SNF vs Chiefs despite PUP activation and full practices; part of recovery plan, no setback.
items.why: Coach Macdonald: plan to get full week work then evaluate next week.
items.implication: SEA backfield continues with current options; no immediate handcuff impact.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (high-ankle sprain) ruled out another week by coach Mike LaFleur; still trying to get right.
items.implication: ARI RB committee continues without him.

items.text: The more I watch Jaylen Warren, the more I love his game. Steelers have something special.
items.opportunity: Pass-catching and overall role in PIT offense.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks. Concerning usage trend.
items.why: Direct snap share data last 3 games.
items.implication: Limited opportunity; sit/flex only in deep leagues until role expands.
